behavior_constraints: Every JSON command output (ingest, timeline, verify, detect, lineage, query, diff, report) must include a top-level "metadata" object.
metadata.command must be the subcommand name (ingest, timeline, verify, detect, lineage, query, diff, report).
metadata.evidence_dir must be the evidence directory path passed to the command.
metadata.timestamp must be an ISO 8601 / RFC3339 UTC timestamp of command execution time.
Existing top-level output fields (status, summary, entries, anomalies, version, etc.) must remain at the top level alongside metadata, not wrapped or moved.
detect --format csv output must remain CSV-only with no JSON metadata object and the CSV header must be the first line.
The report command's top-level output must include metadata with command="report"; nested report sections (ingest, timeline, verify, detect, lineage) do not need their own metadata objects.
Documentation in output_schema.md and spec.md must describe the metadata contract.
affected_prior: printText and main command dispatch/printing logic
entities.summary: This round adds a top-level execution metadata object (tool, version, command, evidence_dir, timestamp) to the JSON output of every command while leaving CSV detect output untouched.

instruction_head:
Update `/app/docs/output_schema.md`, `/app/docs/spec.md`, and the implementation so every command's JSON output includes execution metadata. The existing docs may not contain this metadata contract yet, so use the structure below.

Every JSON command output must include a top-level `"metadata"` object:

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "tool": "mlforge",
    "version": "1.0",
    "command": "detect",
    "evidence_dir": "/tmp/test_evidence",
    "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
  }
}
```
